stories.title: Service Interface and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define canonical service contracts using Pydantic models and explicit interfaces for all layers (facade, application, domain). Include request/response schemas, validation rules, versioned contracts, and anti-corruption boundaries to prevent cross-layer leakage.

stories.title: Core Service Refactor Implementation
stories.description: Refactor domain and shared services into isolated modules aligned to ARCH-001 (9 services), enforcing strict layer boundaries, eliminating implicit dependencies, and centralizing business logic within domain services.

stories.title: Facade Layer Alignment and API Routing
stories.description: Implement facade-driven API access by updating application facades and tool_router to enforce contract-only invocation, ensuring all external interactions route through facades with validated schemas and no direct domain access.

stories.title: Integration Wiring and Dependency Validation
stories.description: Establish integration composition root in main.py with explicit dependency injection, service wiring, and lifecycle management consistent with modular monolith design; include migration orchestration hooks and data transition safeguards aligned to ARCH-001 phased migration.

stories.title: Refactor Regression and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Implement comprehensive unit, integration, and regression tests validating contract enforcement, service isolation, and strict parity with pre-refactor E2E outputs and QA baseline.
